summary: Radar and lookout tower near Atikokan, Ontario; moved to Fort Frances in 1972 and again in 2009. Sources disagree on its build date.

facts.design: Radar and lookout tower with a red-and-white cupola
facts.status_note: Moved to Fort Frances in 1972 and again in 2009; the tower stands on the Rainy River waterfront. No source describes the original site today.

events.note: Sold to the Province of Ontario (District Forester, Department of Lands and Forests, Fort Frances). The register dates construction to the 1930s; the Times gives an RCAF radar origin from 1959.
Moved from near Atikokan and assembled at Point Park, Fort Frances, as a tourist attraction; opened 1 July 1972.
Moved from Point Park to the Sorting Gap Marina on the Rainy River.
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register as CAN 1, ON 1, dated 31 December 2023.

corrections.why: The Times gives the Pal Lake site (joint radar and forestry tower, per Atikokan museum archives) as 48-47-45.5 N, 091-36-41 W. The record point is in Kenora District, about 130 km west of those coordinates. Human check needed against the Atikokan archives before editing.
The register calls it a forest fire lookout and radar tower; the Town calls it a radar and lookout tower. The record's kind is unknown.

notes_for_editor: Build date and purpose conflict. Register and NHLR (1930s forest fire lookout and radar tower, remote Atkikokan) versus the Fort Frances Times, citing Atikokan museum archives (RCAF gap-filler radar project from 1959; tower built but never operational; sold to the Province in 1964; Lands and Forests fire lookout for a few years). The story gives both and does not pick one. The Times article is undated; its COVID-19 reference is relative to its own date. Original-site coordinates in the register (49.162669, -93.325948; Kenora District) do not match the Pal Lake coordinates in the Times (48-47-45.5 N, 091-36-41 W); location correction proposed for human review. Spelling: register and NHLR use Atkikokan, Times and Town use Atikokan; story uses Atikokan. Current tower (Sorting Gap Marina) has its own record (ca-on-fort-frances); its climbing status today is not stated in any source read. Not read: Town historical landmarks page and Sunset Country page. Staffing record has no dates beyond the lookout use in the Times account; as_of is the 1964 sale date, not a staffing date.
